    Maximal nonzero ray paths through an arrow #

    BGRS 8.6 chooses a nonzero path of maximal length through the last arrow of an efficient tackle and annihilates its ray in a residue category. This file packages that finite maximization and its immediate extension obstructions.

    source

    A nonzero irreducible path with a specified occurrence of one selected arrow.

    • target : RayVertex C
    • path : Quiver.Path self.source self.target
    • occurrence : BundledArrowOccurrence a self.path
    • map_ne_zero : rayPathMap self.path ≠ 0
